run_metadata.query: Identify asset owners, port operators, logistics and freight companies, energy infrastructure firms, and data-centre or digital-infrastructure operators headquartered in or primarily active in Switzerland, with exposure to ports, logistics, energy infrastructure, digital infrastructure, and real estate development capable of activating physical assets, corridors, cities, or infrastructure. Prioritize entities showing evidence of patient capital, long-horizon stewardship, and governance discipline.

prospects.name: Energy Infrastructure Partners AG
prospects.brief_description: Energy Infrastructure Partners AG (EIP) is a Swiss manager of collective assets focused on high-quality, large-scale renewables and system-critical energy infrastructure assets, with an unlimited investment horizon and a direct investment approach for institutional investors.
prospects.geography: Switzerland (primarily for direct investments for Swiss pension funds, with global reach for institutional investors)

scoring_signals.core_fit: Swiss manager of collective assets focused on high quality, large-scale renewables and system-critical energy infrastructure assets.
scoring_signals.capital_or_operational_orientation: Unlimited investment horizon. Open-ended structure with a hold-to-maturity approach. Long-term investments.
scoring_signals.sector_alignment: Swiss energy infrastructure, mainly targeting system-critical generation and transmission assets
scoring_signals.governance_institutional_mindset: clients focus primarily on pension funds, insurances and large family offices seeking investments in long-term, stable cash flow-generating assets
scoring_signals.strategic_adjacency_tbp: system-critical generation and transmission assets that are essential for the country's energy security
scoring_signals.engagement_readiness: Dedicated 'For investors' section with named contacts for Client Solutions

prospects.name: Green Datacenter AG
prospects.brief_description: Green Datacenter AG is a leading Swiss-based digital infrastructure platform operating hyperscale and enterprise data centers, committed to sustainable and energy-efficient operations.
prospects.geography: Switzerland (headquartered in Lupfig, with operations in Zurich area, expanding into Germany)

scoring_signals.core_fit: Swiss-based digital infrastructure platform operating hyperscale and enterprise data centres.
scoring_signals.capital_or_operational_orientation: committed to strong governance and a long-term financial strategy. Securing the necessary capital is essential for further investment in sustainable data centers.
scoring_signals.strategic_adjacency_tbp: leader in Switzerland's fast-growing data centre market, benefiting from long-term contracts with leading cloud service providers
scoring_signals.engagement_readiness: Direct email 'request@green.ch' and contact form available.

prospects.name: Alpiq AG
prospects.brief_description: Alpiq AG is a leading Swiss energy company focusing on flexible energy assets, including hydropower, battery storage, and pumped-hydro, driving the European energy transition towards net-zero.
prospects.geography: Switzerland (headquartered in Lausanne) and across Europe (e.g., Finland, France, Germany)

scoring_signals.core_fit: one of the leading providers of flexibility – an increasingly indispensable pillar of the energy system.
scoring_signals.capital_or_operational_orientation: committed to significantly increasing investments in flexible assets up to CHF 1 billion per year
scoring_signals.sector_alignment: flexible infrastructure, including battery storage and pumped hydro
scoring_signals.governance_institutional_mindset: information policy is based on transparency, topicality and continuity.
scoring_signals.strategic_adjacency_tbp: strengthening its role in the European energy transition
